scope: real PostgreSQL 17.6, two sessions, synthetic baseline; vector retrieval and hosted Supabase not covered

results.case: policy and complete record/review migrations apply to the synthetic baseline
two independent sessions claim disjoint candidates concurrently
targeted rerun cannot steal an unexpired lease
expired lease can be reclaimed; stale worker cannot renew or complete
enqueue during an active run preserves ownership and requests a later rerun
real SQL preserves synthetic human not-fit and dormant states and permits explicit human reopening
concurrent reservations obey one cap and uncertain calls retain their allowance
two independent sessions claim disjoint outbox items without sending anything
new worker mutation RPC is restricted to the service role
concurrent nightly transactions create proposals once; same-run restart preserves completed progress
zero-result candidates still complete and record progress
failed assessment rolls back progress; reopened old job is reconsidered on retry without a pipeline-date cursor
fact bundles are idempotent and stale source snapshots are refused
scorecard draft importer cannot forge human confirmation
migration reapplication imports legacy costs once and never double-counts already-metered panels
